- No guessing: each chosen field has explicit textual evidence.
- Preserve decimal places as in input (two decimals).
- Convert commas to decimal points for numeric fields (418,19 -> 418.19; 41,82 -> 41.82; 460,01 -> 460.01).
- Vat.Rate returned as number 10 (not "10%").
- Sender.VatId returned as string without extra spacing: "ATU43349701".
